description:
New to the market with Tony Donnelly of Leonard Wilson Keenan, this fantastic four-bedroom detached bungalow offers the perfect blend of modern luxury, energy efficiency, and tranquil rural living. Boasting an impressive B energy rating, this pristine family home is packed with premium upgrades and is ready for immediate occupation.

Key Features & Modern Upgrades

•	Energy Efficient: B-rated energy efficiency with a flexible dual heating system and a modern EV electric car charger.
•	Premium Security & Access: Secure entry via electric gates opening onto a pristine tarmacadam driveway with ample parking.
•	Turn-Key Condition: The property has been meticulously maintained and comes to the market in pristine, walk-in condition throughout.
•	Outdoor Oasis: Beautifully landscaped gardens wrap around the home, featuring a quiet rural backdrop with panoramic countryside views to the rear

	
Spacious & Thoughtful Accommodation

Living & Entertaining Areas

•	Heart of the Home: A spectacular, light-filled open-plan kitchen, dining area to the rear.
•	Formal Sitting Room: A bright and welcoming separate reception room positioned off the main hallway. This space features a cozy solid fuel stove and direct access to the dining area—perfect for family gatherings
•	Utility & Convenience: A fully equipped utility room and a practical guest W/C located by the back door.

Bedrooms & Bathrooms

•	Entrance Hallway: A bright, wide, and welcoming entrance that sets the tone for the rest of the home.
•	Four Double Bedrooms: Generously proportioned double bedrooms offering plenty of space and natural light.
•	Master Suite: Features a private, fully fitted en-suite bathroom.
•	Family Bathroom: A fantastic, modern main bathroom serving the remaining bedroom

An Ideal Location: Situated in a peaceful, scenic rural setting just off the R414 Rathangan to Monasterevin road, this home offers country living without sacrificing connectivity:

•	Schools & Amenities: Within easy access to Rathangan town, including excellent local primary and secondary schools.
•	Commuter Friendly: A short drive to the M7 Motorway, accessible via Junction 13 (Kildare Village) or Junction 14 (Mayfield Service Station) for an easy commute to Dublin and beyond.
